english.title: Fail to comply with duty to make good the surface of a path / indicate the line of a path
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of land at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) who had disturbed the surface of a

(A)_[footpath]_
(B)_[bridleway]_

under the right conferred by section 134(1) of the Highways Act 1980, failed to comply with the duty, within

(C)_[the relevant period,]_
(D)_[an extension of the relevant period granted under section 134(8) of the Act,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..), to

(E)_[so make good the surface of the path to not less than its minimum width as to make it reasonably convenient for the exercise of the right of way]_
(F)_[so make good the surface of the way to not less than its minimum width as to make it reasonably convenient for the exercise of the right of way]_
(G)_[so indicate the line of the path on the ground to not less than its minimum width that was apparent to members of the public wishing to use it]_
(H)_[so indicate the line of the way on the ground to not less than its minimum width that was apparent to members of the public wishing to use it]_
(I)_[so make good the surface of the path to not less than its minimum width as to make it reasonably convenient for the exercise of the right of way and so indicate the line of the path on the ground to not less than its minimum width that was apparent to members of the public wishing to use it]_
(J)_[so make good the surface of the way to not less than its minimum width as to make it reasonably convenient for the exercise of the right of way and so indicate the line of the way on the ground to not less than its minimum width that was apparent to members of the public wishing to use it]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 134(4) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed to comply with duty
imposed by section 134(3)

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) Offence start date in Wales is 1st May 2001.
